solutions.title: Top-down DP by row and index
solutions.strategy: Build a DP table where each value is the minimum path sum reaching that position.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every stored triangle value is processed once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The DP table mirrors the triangle values.

solutions.title: Bottom-up in-place row buffer
solutions.strategy: Start with the bottom row as suffix costs and fold each upper row into that buffer.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every triangle value is combined with two child costs once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the bottom-row-sized cost buffer is retained.
